mentions.name: DarkRadiant
mentions.description: Open source, cross platform level editor for The Dark Mod and other idTech4 games such as Doom 3, Quake 4 and Prey, with features aimed at making level designers more productive. Built with wxWidgets and CSG techniques.
mentions.audience: Level designers creating content for The Dark Mod and other idTech4 games
